decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.6% and the S&P 500 down 1.2%, putting us in a clear risk-off environment. The screener returned no candidates, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing new buys into weakness.

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices harder than the broader market today, with NASDAQ's 2.6% decline outpacing the S&P 500's 1.2% drop, a pattern typical of risk-off days where investors rotate out of higher-growth, higher-valuation names first. Without specific confirmed headlines available today, the move looks consistent with general risk aversion rather than a single catalyst. We're treating this as a day to protect capital rather than chase dips.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌,科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅達2.6%,跌幅遠超標普500指數的1.2%,反映典型的「risk-off」(避險)情緒——投資者率先拋售高增長、高估值的股份。今日未有確認具體新聞標題,但整體走勢符合普遍避險心理,而非單一事件觸發。我們選擇今日按兵不動,保存實力,而非趁低吸納。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares, moving toward safety. It's a signal to be cautious with new purchases, not necessarily to sell everything — existing positions with good fundamentals can often ride out the volatility.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」(避險)日是指投資者普遍減持風險較高的資產,例如增長股和科技股,轉向更安全的選擇。這是提醒我們對新買入要審慎,但不一定要清倉——基本面良好的現有持股通常可以撐過這些波動。
